The original Pixar Theory ► https://www.pixartheory.com/ 
 
It’s been over a DECADE since our original Pixar Theory, so it’s time to rebuild from the ground up! Does The Incredibles actually take place in 1962? Was there a human apocalypse prior to Cars? And what’s REALLY going on with that Pizza Planet truck? At the end of the day, all roads lead back to Hoppers, Theorists…
